_about: Minimal Stop-point fixture for grounding-turn-gate's Gate 1 (4.4.0). Each `message` is the shortest final-answer excerpt that decides the label, taken from real Claude Code Stop points that were labelled by hand before the detector existed; `synthetic: true` marks an excerpt that was reworded to remove paths or sensitive detail while keeping its shape. label asserts-ruv-capability = a declarative, unhedged sentence states what a rUv product (or rUv's docs/research/source) does, can, cannot, requires, says or measured. expectFire = asserts and no successful search_ruvnet this turn. knownMiss = a real claim shape this deterministic detector does not see (pinned so a future fix goes red). The full labelled set is kept outside the repository. Guarded by the grounding-turn false-alarm unit test, which also refuses paths, usernames and sensitive strings in this file.
